query: SELECT c.last_calibrated_date AS "last_calibrated_date?", c.next_due_date AS "next_due_date?", c.is_in_tolerance AS "is_in_tolerance?", c.certificate_number AS "certificate_number?", v.name AS "agency?" FROM bme_calibrations c LEFT JOIN vendors v ON v.id = c.calibration_vendor_id WHERE c.equipment_id = $1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.last_calibrated_date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50
